# NARI Health

> NARI is a women-led holistic health platform in India offering physiotherapy, psychology, and nutrition consultations — online and via home visits.

NARI was founded to give women integrated, evidence-based care in a single place. The platform brings together certified physiotherapists, licensed psychologists, and clinical nutritionists who specialize in women's health concerns including PCOS, hormonal imbalance, pelvic floor conditions, mental wellness, and nutrition.

## Services

- **Physiotherapy** — Women's health physiotherapy: PCOS, pelvic floor, posture, chronic pain
- **Psychology** — Evidence-based mental health support; understanding the emotional dimensions of women's health
- **Nutrition** — Personalized nutrition plans; hormonal health, cycle syncing, long-term wellbeing

## Plans

- Saathi (Basic): ₹199/session — 1-on-1 consultation, basic assessment, session summary
- Shakti (PRO): ₹2,999/month — 4 physio sessions, diet plan, mental support, 24/7 WhatsApp care, progress tracking
- Sampurna (Premium): ₹7,499/month — Full hormonal reset protocol, all specialties, priority appointments, community access
